assumptions.environment: Godot CPU simulation and worker IPC are expected to bottleneck before learner throughput unless many workers are batched.
assumptions.policy: Shared recurrent actor. Full profile uses centralized critic and optional local-grid CNN.

profiles.purpose: Local smoke training, reward/observation debugging, and small recurrent policies.
profiles.hardware_class: single local compute card, 8GB VRAM class
profiles.ram_gb: Use available system memory for rollout storage and optimizer offload.
profiles.expected_wall_time: Useful for short smoke jobs immediately; multi-million-step local training depends on worker IPC throughput.
profiles.notes: Can reduce VRAM pressure with CPU rollout storage, optimizer offload, smaller recurrent state, and gradient accumulation. This trades speed for capacity.

profiles.purpose: Complete four-map recurrent MAPPO self-play league.
profiles.expected_wall_time: Several days to around two weeks depending on worker throughput and card count.
profiles.notes: Use this after the local profile validates observations, rewards, reset behavior, and evaluation gates.

recommendation.start_here: Run local_constrained smoke and worker throughput benchmarks first.
recommendation.local_target: Use local_constrained for stages 01-03 and single-map bug finding.
recommendation.full_target: Use full_distributed_league for final self-play league and human-evaluation-ready checkpoints.
recommendation.first_benchmark: Measure Godot env steps/sec at 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16 local workers before deciding whether to raise model size.
